payload.posture: Read Psalms 80:1–7 as one movement in Joseph's story, keeping the passage's actions, setting, sequence, and limits visible.
payload.tension: The passage states the prayer speaks Joseph as a flock, names Ephraim, Benjamin, and Manasseh, and repeatedly asks God to restore and shine. It does not by itself supply every cause or later interpretation of this part of Joseph's story.
